Total due is cut off in both screenshots; A at least shows a rule above it, and B also adds a 2026 year to the dates that the request didn't give. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both invoices right-align their money columns and numeric headers, use two decimals with consistent $ signs, and mark the discount with a minus sign. Neither screenshot shows the Total due row itself, and A adds a year (2026) to the dates that wasn't in the request.
